title: Object Oriented Programming I: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
instructions: Answer question 1 (compulsory) and any other 2 questions.

parts.text: How is typedef used in c++? Explain using a section program.
What is a data type? Explain any three fundamental data types used in c language.
What is inheritance? Explain any two types of inheritance used in c++.
Briefly explain the three access specifiers giving details on how they are used.

Consider the following code. You are required to identify the errors and rewrite the program in a way that it can execute. #include<iostream> #define PI=3.1416; Int main() { Double r; Area=0.0; Do{ Cout>("Enter radius of circle"); Scanf("%f",&r); }while(r<0.) Area=PI*pow(r,2); Cout>>"Area is %f",area; }
Explain any five concepts of object oriented programming.
Write a program in C++ which uses a class and a method to perform addition of two interger numbers at runtime.
Explain how values are passed in functions.
With the help of a sample program, explain the structure of a c++ program.
With the help of a program, explain how inheritance can be implemented in a program. Use any program of your choice for explanation.
Explain into details, why a program may be referred to us as object oriented.
Explain the three blocks of exception handling and use an example program that divides by zero.

Describe the mechanism of accessing data members and member functions in the following cases i. Inside the main program. ii. Inside a member function of the same class. iii. Inside a member function of another class.
Explain the dynamic memory allocation mechanism using C++ features.
What is an array? Explain how arrays are declared and how values in array can be accessed. Use a sample program for your explanation.
